title: Paired wire assignment
statement: For a nonnegative integer $n$ and a finite Boolean list $r$, the paired wire assignment on $2n+2+|r|$ positions is the function whose list of values is obtained by listing every input index twice in order, then the constants false and true, then the entries of $r$ as constant wires.
